simple.meaning: זִמְרָת (zimrâth) is a Hebrew word meaning “instrumental music ; by implication, praise.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: זִמְרָת (H2176) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Exodus 15:2, with occurrences in Exodus, Psalms, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זִמְרָת (H2176) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in זִמְרָת (H2176) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: זִמְרָת (zimrâth) / H2176 is traced through Exodus 15:2, Psalms 118:14, Isaiah 12:2 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
